subject: Recap: discovery + Mutual Action Plan — confirm owners & timing
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finaxis.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + Mutual Action Plan — confirm owners & timing

Tom — great talk today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: we covered your primary inference pain points (bursty billing spikes, prefix latency on longer contexts, and the need for an isolation option for regulated datasets). Based on that, I put together a one-page Mutual Action Plan with proposed owners and dates attached (FinAxis_Redwood_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx).

What I need from you: could you confirm the owner(s) on your side for each milestone (evaluation lead, infra lead, legal owner) and whether the proposed 6-week evaluation window starting 2027-06-07 still looks feasible? If the timeline changed, no problem — tell us where to align.

Proposed next step: if owners and dates look good, we’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff on the first day of the window to provision a dedicated test pool and run the initial throughput baseline. If not, we can shift the start or scope.

Thanks — looping in Logan (SE) to scope the pilot instrumentation.

—
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: FinAxis_Redwood_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finaxis.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + Mutual Action Plan — confirm owners & timing

Quick bump — wanted to make sure the MAP landed in your inbox. We’re holding the proposed evaluation window on our side while you confirm owners/dates. If priority shifted, totally understand — a 1-line update is fine (e.g., "shift to Q3" or "still on for June").

If helpful I can also loop in a short 15-min alignment to lock owners; Logan can join to walk the pilot checklist.

Thanks,
Priya

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + Mutual Action Plan — confirm owners & timing

Tom — circling again as I haven’t heard back. If this slipped off your radar, a quick call could be the fastest way to lock names/dates. Suggested 15-min slots this week: Tue 17 May 11:00–11:15 PT, Wed 18 May 09:00–09:15 PT, or Thu 19 May 14:00–14:15 PT. If none work, tell me a time that does and I’ll send a calendar invite.

If timelines shifted to Q3 (or later), we can also capture that in the MAP and adjust the rollout commitments accordingly — we want the plan to reflect your internal cadence, not ours.

Logan is standing by to confirm the infra checklist once owners are set. Appreciate any update you can share.

—
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finaxis.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finaxis.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + Mutual Action Plan — confirm owners & timing

Hi Priya — sorry for the delay, we were heads down on a release. Thanks for the follow-ups and for the clear MAP. Quick answers:

- Evaluation lead: Sara Patel (copied)
- Infra contact: Raj Mehta (not CC'd here; I'll introduce him after I sync internally)
- Legal owner: I'll route to procurement but expect Karen Liu to pick this up
- Timeline: our priority shifted slightly — we want to move the evaluation window to start 2027-08-02 (Q3).

Sara has reviewed the MAP and provided a couple of minor edits; attached is a redline with comments (FinAxis_MPA_redline.docx). We’re still interested — please revise dates to reflect the August start and we’ll confirm the kickoff once Raj is looped.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform Engineering, FinAxis
tom.reynolds@finaxis.com | +1 650-555-0147

Attachment: FinAxis_MPA_redline.docx (document, 22KB)
